== Summary ==
Title banner for [[Virtual Block 9]] ("Republic At War"), from the cover page of the Virtual Block 9.1: Republic At War PDF. Its cover reads "Official text as of January 10, 2014". The file was created on 17 January 2014.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_1.pdf VirtualBlock9_1.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Page 1 rendered at 300 dpi, the resolution of the embedded cover image, and cropped to the banner (1953&times;1203 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174637/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_1.pdf Internet Archive].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-0/09/Set-VB9-logo.jpg Internet Archive item].
